spurious_features.label: interjections and filler words
spurious_features.reason: Filler/discourse marker, not semantic NLI content.

spurious_features.label: expressions of agreement or acknowledgement, particularly "well" and "yeah"
spurious_features.reason: Agreement marker; purely conversational and noncausal.

causal_features.label: the word "because"
causal_features.reason: Generic connective; not entailment-specific semantic evidence.

causal_features.label: the word "the"
causal_features.reason: Common article; structural, not causal semantic relation.

other_features.label: the letter "t" when it follows the word "isn'" or "doesn'"
other_features.reason: Negation-related token detector; oracle says it has strong effect.

notes: Oracle cites superficial markers; generic keywords are treated as other, not causal.
